selection.test_crowd_policy: Exclude candidate photo if any of the 12 target categories has a crowd annotation.
selection.dev_crowd_policy: Ignore only target/photo pairs with a target crowd annotation; retain the photo for other targets.
selection.positive_stratum_eligibility: At least one target box with min edge16pixels and area>=1% of image. All noncrowd boxes, including smaller incidental targets, define evaluation truth.
selection.reference_crop: Original v14 single boxed support; floor left/top, ceil right/bottom, clip to image; no query annotation is a model input.

protocol.primary: Macro localized recall: accepted highest-score box overlaps any target GT box at IoU>=0.5.
protocol.cutoff: One global cutoff per method from all valid DEV target-absent pairs; no TEST tuning.
protocol.confidence_intervals: Paired resampling of query photos, carrying all 12 target outcomes together; references/calibration fixed.

limitations: Fresh means absent from prior HyperNet photo iterations, not unseen by the pretrained OWL checkpoint.
COCO is named in OWL training; no absence of pretraining overlap or novel category status is established.
One boxed support per category is additional annotation; 288 labeled DEV photos are supervision beyond the support.
COCO absence means no supplied annotation; missing labels and physical-instance duplicates may remain.
Selected source strata are not natural prevalence. False alarms per10000 are normalized rates, not certification of rare-event operation.
Top1 localized recall is a custom metric, not the published COCO AP metric.
